agent.label: About
agent.heading: Redefining how homes are shown.
body: I'm Jana. For nine years I've represented residences on the Costa del Sol for owners who would rather sell quietly and well than loudly and fast.
Every property I take on is filmed properly — walked through, in natural light, start to finish. Buyers decide from the film. By the time we meet at the door, the conversation is already serious.

steps.title: Send your details
steps.body: Email and phone is enough. No forms about your budget, no qualification quiz.

steps.title: I call within 24h
steps.body: A short call to understand what you're looking for — or what you're selling. In English or Spanish.

steps.title: We view privately
steps.body: Viewings arranged around you, typically within 48 hours. No open houses, no crowds.

items.q: What does it cost me as a buyer?
items.a: Nothing. The seller pays the commission. You pay the purchase price, taxes and your own legal fees — I'll give you a written breakdown before you commit to anything.
A single percentage of the achieved sale price, agreed in writing before we start, payable only on completion. No upfront fees, no marketing charges, no photography invoices.

items.q: Can I buy in Spain as a non-resident?
items.a: Yes. You'll need an NIE number and a Spanish bank account, both of which take days rather than weeks. I work with a gestor and an independent lawyer who handle this routinely.
I don't broker them, but I'll introduce you to two independent brokers who lend to non-residents, typically at 60–70% loan-to-value. You're free to use your own.

items.q: How quickly can I see a property?
items.a: Usually within 48 hours, including weekends. If you're flying in, tell me your dates and I'll group viewings into a single day.

items.q: Are these all the properties you have?
items.a: These six are the ones currently filmed and publicly shown. There is always off-market stock that never reaches a website — ask me on the call.
